title: Chicken Karahi

seo.title: How to Make Chicken Karahi — Easy Pakistani Recipe
seo.metaDescription: Learn how to make authentic Chicken Karahi. This easy Pakistani recipe includes step-by-step instructions, tips, and serving ideas.
h2Headings: Pro Tips for the Best Results
seo.imageCaption: Delicious homemade Chicken Karahi — a beloved Pakistani classic

description: Chicken Karahi is a quintessential Pakistani dish, famed for its rich, spicy tomato-ginger base and tender chicken. Cooked traditionally in a wok-like karahi, it embodies robust flavors and a vibrant aroma that is truly irresistible. This quick and easy recipe brings the authentic taste of Pakistan's roadside dhabas right to your kitchen.

instructions.title: Sear the Chicken
instructions.text: Heat cooking oil in a large karahi or heavy-bottomed pan over medium-high heat. Add the chicken pieces and fry until they change color and are lightly browned, about 5-7 minutes.

instructions.title: Add Ginger-Garlic Paste
instructions.text: Add ginger paste and garlic paste to the chicken. Sauté for 2-3 minutes until fragrant, ensuring the pastes are well combined with the chicken.

instructions.title: Incorporate Tomatoes and Spices
instructions.text: Add the chopped tomatoes to the karahi. Stir well, then add salt, red chilli powder, turmeric powder, cumin powder, and coriander powder. Mix thoroughly to coat the chicken and tomatoes.

instructions.title: Cook Down and Mash Tomatoes
instructions.text: Cover the karahi and cook on medium heat for 10-12 minutes, allowing the tomatoes to soften and release their juices. Once soft, uncover and mash the tomatoes with the back of your spoon or spatula until they form a thick gravy. Continue cooking until the oil separates from the masala.

instructions.title: Add Green Chillies and Yogurt
instructions.text: Stir in the slit green chillies. If using, add the whisked yogurt now and mix continuously to prevent curdling. Cook for another 5-7 minutes until the yogurt blends perfectly into the gravy and the oil rises to the top.

instructions.title: Garnish and Simmer
instructions.text: Sprinkle with garam masala, julienned fresh ginger, and chopped fresh coriander. Cover and simmer on low heat for 2-3 minutes to allow the flavors to meld and infuse.

instructions.title: Serve Hot
instructions.text: Serve the authentic Chicken Karahi hot directly from the karahi with freshly baked naan, roti, or steamed rice for a complete Pakistani meal.

tips: Always use bone-in chicken for a richer flavor and juicier texture, as the bones contribute significantly to the depth of the gravy.
For an extra kick, lightly crush a few whole black peppercorns and add them along with the other spices.
The key to a perfect karahi is vigorous mashing of the tomatoes until they completely dissolve into a smooth, thick gravy, ensuring no chunky pieces remain.
article:
Dive into the vibrant culinary landscape of Pakistan, and you'll quickly discover a dish that reigns supreme: Chicken Karahi. This iconic, fiery, and utterly delicious preparation is a staple in homes, restaurants, and roadside eateries across the subcontinent and beyond. Known for its rich tomato-ginger-garlic base and aromatic spices, Chicken Karahi isn't just a meal; it's an experience. If you've ever craved a dish that perfectly balances heat with profound flavor, you're in for a treat. This article will guide you through everything you need to know about making an authentic Chicken Karahi, a true gem among Pakistani chicken recipes, right in your own kitchen.

## What is Chicken Karahi?
At its heart, Chicken Karahi is a traditional Pakistani and North Indian curry, cooked and often served in a 'karahi' – a heavy, deep cooking pot similar to a wok. Unlike many curries relying on onions, an authentic Karahi typically uses a powerful base of fresh tomatoes, ginger, and garlic, making it robust and tangy. Its beauty lies in simplicity and quick cooking, often over high heat. Chicken is usually bone-in for deeper flavor. Spices are minimal but potent, focusing on green chilies, black pepper, and red chili powder, allowing natural flavors to shine. It's celebrated for its 'bhuna' style – ingredients sautéed until oil separates, creating a thick, intensely flavored gravy that clings to the chicken.

## Ingredients You Need
To embark on your culinary journey to create the perfect Chicken Karahi, gather these essential ingredients. Quality fresh ingredients are key to an authentic taste:
*   **Chicken:** 1.5 kg (approx. 3.3 lbs) bone-in, skinless chicken, cut into medium pieces. Bone-in enhances flavor significantly.
*   **Tomatoes:** 5-6 medium-sized ripe tomatoes, finely chopped or pureed.
*   **Ginger-Garlic Paste:** 2-3 tablespoons, freshly made if possible. This is a flavor cornerstone.
*   **Green Chilies:** 4-6, slit lengthwise or finely chopped, depending on your spice preference.
*   **Fresh Ginger:** 2-inch piece, julienned for garnish and flavor.
*   **Fresh Coriander (Cilantro):** A generous handful, chopped, for garnish.
*   **Yogurt (optional):** 1/2 cup plain full-fat
